briefing: Markets were neutral today with NASDAQ -0.6% and S&P 500 -0.4%. With cash above the $500 threshold and open slots available, we made one selective medium-conviction buy in HPQ, the top-scored candidate with multiple bullish technical confirmations, while holding the rest of the portfolio unchanged.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum confirmation means waiting for multiple technical signals — like RSI in a healthy range, a MACD bullish crossover, and price above its moving average — to line up before buying, rather than acting on just one signal. This reduces the chance of buying into a false breakout.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能確認是指在買入前，等待多個技術訊號（例如RSI處於健康區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價站上均線）同時出現，而非只憑單一訊號行動。這樣可以降低誤判假突破的風險。

market_education.summary_en: Broad indices drifted lower today with NASDAQ down 0.6% and the S&P 500 down 0.4%, reflecting a neutral, low-conviction trading session rather than any major catalyst. No single sector or headline drove the move, consistent with a consolidation day after recent gains. In this environment, we favored selective, technically-confirmed buys over broad deployment of cash.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢偏軟，納指下跌0.6%，標普500下跌0.4%，屬於中性、缺乏方向的交易日，並無重大消息面催化。此走勢較似整固階段，並非受單一板塊或新聞事件主導。在此環境下，我們選擇僅對技術面訊號齊備的個股進行小規模買入，而非全數動用現金。

trades.reasoning: Top-scored candidate (95) with RSI in the bullish 55-70 zone, MACD bullish crossover with rising histogram, and price above SMA-20, offering partial deployment of idle cash above the $500 threshold despite a neutral market.
